query: Find for sale by owner properties in Chicago IL with owner and agent contact information

findings.candidate_name: Zillow Chicago IL FSBO Listings (69 active)
findings.evidence_snippet: Zillow shows 69 for-sale-by-owner listings in Chicago IL as of search date. Buyers can browse photos, filter by criteria, and contact sellers directly. Owner contact info is accessible per listing on the Zillow listing page.

findings.candidate_name: Zillow Chicago Real Estate Agent Directory
findings.evidence_snippet: Zillow's Chicago IL professional directory lets users view and compare real estate agents, read reviews, see current listings, and contact agents directly from profile pages — useful for identifying listing agents on FSBO-adjacent properties.
Zillow has 4 homes in Chicago IL listed with owner financing available, representing an overlapping segment of owner-direct transactions where direct owner contact is possible.

findings.candidate_name: FSBO.com — For Sale By Owner Platform
findings.evidence_snippet: WHOIS confirms fsbo.com is a long-standing domain (created ~1998, expiry 2032) registered via Network Solutions. The site aggregates FSBO listings nationally including Chicago IL; registrant details are privacy-protected.

Web search surfaced realtor.com as a secondary source for Chicago IL listing agent and owner contact lookups alongside Zillow, per the query 'listing agent OR owner contact Chicago IL site:realtor.com'.

findings.candidate_name: Contact Enrichment Tools (Hunter.io, Apollo, Pipl, OpenCorporates, Phone OSINT)
findings.evidence_snippet: All five enrichment tools (Hunter.io, Apollo, Pipl, OpenCorporates, Phone OSINT via Numverify) returned API key configuration errors. Owner name, email, phone, and LLC officer data fields are 'not found (or tool unavailable)' pending API key setup.
